title: A lost expedition
summary: Lose an expedition and you go home. You can try it again.
text:
If an expedition's Command Core falls, the expedition is **lost**. Its base is gone, and the end screen offers the way back to your home colony.

It isn't the end of the campaign: your home colony is untouched, and the region's mission can be tried again from the start. Go back with a fresh kit and what you learned the first time.

Losing your **home** colony is different: that ends the campaign.
